r0020: 6.  On 16 October 1996 the Commission declared the application admissible.
r0021: 7.  On 28 May 1997 the Commission decided to adjourn its examination of the case pending its decision in Immobiliare Saffi v. Italy. On 27 May 1998 the Commission resumed its examination of the case and invited the parties to submit additional observations. The applicant and the Government submitted their observations on 16 and 19 June 1998 respectively.
r0022: 8.  As the Commission had not completed its examination of the application by 1 November 1999, it referred it to the Court on that date in accordance with Article 5 § 3, second sentence, of Protocol No. 11 to the Convention.
r0023: 9.  The application was allocated to the Second Section of the Court (Rule 52 § 1 of the Rules of Court). Within that Section, the Chamber that would consider the case (Article 27 § 1 of the Convention) was constituted as provided in Rule 26 § 1. Following the withdrawal of Mr Conforti, the judge elected in respect of Italy (Rule 28), the Government waived their right to appoint an ad hoc judge to sit in his place (Article 27 § 2 of the Convention and Rule 29 § 2).
r0025: I.  THE CIRCUMSTANCES OF THE CASE
r0026: 10.  The applicant is the owner of an apartment in Pescara, which he had let to W.A. from 6 July 1983. On 30 May 1987 the tenant’s wife, L.C., informed the applicant that, following their judicial separation, she had succeeded her husband as the tenant under the lease. She had a dependent child and a monthly income of 577,000 Italian lire (ITL).
r0027: 11.  In a registered letter of 3 September 1987, the applicant asked L.C. to vacate the apartment, as the lease had expired on 30 June 1987.
r0028: 12.  In a writ served on 24 September 1987, the applicant summoned her to appear before the Pescara magistrate (*juge d’instance*).
r0029: 13.  In an order of 9 October 1987, which became enforceable on 10 October 1987, the magistrate formally confirmed the notice to quit and ordered that the premises be vacated by 9 October 1988 at the latest.
